[[File:Allspark portrait.png|thumb|220x220px]]
The''' Allspark''' is a special relic introduced January 2019.

==Description==
''A mysterious cube that holds the power to create worlds. Mechanical devices come to life in it's presence, and Deceptions across the Universe crave its power.''

==Relic Boosts==
+5% Attack and Health in all game modes.

==Obtainment==
20 Relic Tickets
